component.name: BetterNotes
component.summary: Sticky notes for the Linux desktop

description.p: BetterNotes is an open-source, Linux-first sticky notes and desktop workspace application built with Rust and Qt 6. Designed for performance, data privacy, and keyboard-first productivity, it provides independent floating note windows with persistent geometry, full-text search, and desktop integration across modern Linux environments.

ul.li: Native Wayland and X11 support with compositor compatibility policies for KDE Plasma, GNOME, XFCE, Hyprland, and Sway
Instant offline SQLite storage with FTS5 full-text search and tagging
Independent, resizable sticky notes with always-on-top window pin support
Quick Capture scratchpad and Command Palette (Ctrl+K)
One-time and recurring desktop reminders (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
Safe file and image attachments stored isolated in XDG data directories
Data sovereignty: JSON and Markdown import/export, atomic crash-safe backup and recovery
Single-instance Unix domain socket IPC and unified CLI interface
Modern dark, light, and system-adaptive visual themes

description.p: Reminders for each note, editable from the note or the library; bulleted and numbered list buttons; the app icon in the applications menu and in notifications; images drawn in their colours; and the desktop font as the default note font.
One-command curl installer, saving images from a note, and the application icon in the Wayland taskbar for the AppImage.
Animated GIFs, image resizing and drag and drop, automatic lists, tag chips, installing into the applications menu, and a visible window and tray icon.
First packaged preview of BetterNotes for Linux desktop environments.
